Phase 3 · Approval gate

Defend the Recommendation

Make the recommendation visible, auditable, and defensible under pressure.

Decision question

Can every committee member defend the same evidence-linked recommendation to the panel?

Integrate the committee's work into a concise decision package and defend the client recommendations before an investment-committee panel.

Committee motion

Motion to issue the committee's final recommendation and implementation plan for all assigned clients.

Workstreams

Decision memo

State the recommendation first, then connect the market view, client mandate, portfolio, and risk decision.

Technical exhibit book

Present the auditable evidence: scenarios, IPS constraints, allocations, securities, stress results, and sources.

Committee defense

Deliver a visual pitch, answer adversarial questions, and show that all four members understand the integrated decision.

Required evidence

  • Executive recommendation and decision memo
  • Technical exhibit book linking macro, mandate, allocation, securities, and risk
  • Client-specific recommendation for all three assigned clients
  • Final decision record with vote, reservations, and implementation actions
  • Visual oral presentation with balanced speaking time
  • Cross-functional Q&A preparation

Committee responsibilities

Committee seatResponsibility in Phase 3
Client and Macro StrategistDefend client suitability, the macro assumptions, and the line from discovered need to recommendation.
Fixed-Income AnalystDefend the portfolio's income, capital-preservation, interest-rate, and credit-risk trade-offs.
Fund and ETF AnalystDefend vehicle selection, implementation feasibility, diversification, and product-level due diligence.
Portfolio Manager and Risk AnalystState the integrated recommendation, present the strongest downside case, and lead preparation for adversarial Q&A.

Approval standard

Gate 3

Issue the final recommendation, record dissent or reservations, and defend the evidence. Every member must answer questions outside the workstream they led.

The decision record must state the motion, evidence reviewed, each member's vote, any dissent or reservation, and the owner and due date for every required revision.
